entity_value.description: The identifier exactly as written in the ticket. Never invented.
entity_value.title: Entity Value

description: Triage decision where critical urgency is derived from three reported facts.

summary.description: One third-person sentence stating the issue, with concrete identifiers.
summary.title: Summary

extracted_entities.description: Identifiers literally present in the ticket; empty list if none.
extracted_entities.title: Extracted Entities

data_loss_reported.description: True if the ticket reports records, files or history deleted, overwritten or missing.
data_loss_reported.title: Data Loss Reported

security_exposure_reported.description: True if passwords, keys or tokens were shown or leaked, data was visible to people who should not see it, or someone accessed an account without authorisation.
security_exposure_reported.title: Security Exposure Reported

full_outage_reported.description: True only if a WHOLE production service, product or API endpoint is unavailable: nothing loads, or every call fails. False if one function fails while the rest of the product still works.
full_outage_reported.title: Full Outage Reported

urgency.description: Business impact. Must be critical if any *_reported field is true, and only then.

requires_human_escalation.description: True if a human must review before any automated response.
requires_human_escalation.title: Requires Human Escalation

confidence_score.description: Calibrated probability that category AND urgency are both correct.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

title: TicketTriageWithTriggers
